nodes.description: Mapping address => Holder storing each user's unlockTime and balance in contract ultra_bank.
Reference to the Log contract used for event/message logging in ultra_bank.
Public minimum balance (1 ether) required before a Collect withdrawal.
Public payable Put function: credits msg.value to caller's Holder and sets unlockTime.
Public payable Collect function: checks MinSum, requested amount and unlockTime, then sends ether via msg.sender.call.value().
Anonymous payable fallback function that forwards to Put(0).
Constructor of ultra_bank that wires the Log contract address into LogFile.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as key into Acc and as target of the external call.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced timestamp used for unlockTime clamping and comparisons.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() low-level external send in Collect executed before the balance decrement (reentrancy vector).
Parameter _unlockTime of Put, stored into acc.unlockTime.
Parameter _am of Collect, the requested withdrawal amount.
Constructor parameter log, the address of the Log contract.
Local reference acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Local reference acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.
Public Message[] array in Log accumulating all logged messages.
Temporary Message struct in Log populated before being pushed into History.
Public AddMessage in Log: writes Sender, Time (now), Val and Data into LastMsg and pushes to History.
Parameter _adr of AddMessage, the recorded sender address.
Parameter _val of AddMessage, the recorded value.
Parameter _data of AddMessage, the recorded message string.

edges.reason: Put parameter _unlockTime flows into acc.unlockTime assignment.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key Acc[msg.sender] in Put, so the caller controls which account is credited.
block.timestamp (now) clamps _unlockTime in Put, making the stored unlock time miner/timestamp dependent.
Acc[msg.sender] state variable is read into the local acc reference in Put.
Collect parameter _am flows into the balance check and into the external call value.
msg.sender selects the caller's Acc entry and is the receiver of the external call in Collect.
block.timestamp (now) is compared against acc.unlockTime in Collect, gating withdrawal.
Local acc (Acc[msg.sender]) is read and updated for balance accounting in Collect.
Collect reaches the low-level external call msg.sender.call.value(_am)() inside the withdrawal branch.
The external call executes before acc.balance is decremented in Acc, allowing re-entrant withdrawal against stale state.
Fallback function unconditionally calls Put(0).
Constructor parameter log flows into the LogFile assignment.
Constructor writes the LogFile state variable from the supplied Log address.
AddMessage parameter _adr flows into LastMsg.Sender.
AddMessage parameter _val flows into LastMsg.Val.
AddMessage parameter _data flows into LastMsg.Data.
block.timestamp (now) is recorded as LastMsg.Time in AddMessage, creating timestamp dependency in log data.
AddMessage writes the LastMsg state variable.
LastMsg is pushed into the History state array.
Put calls LogFile.AddMessage, transferring control to the Log contract.
Collect calls LogFile.AddMessage after a successful withdrawal.

normalization_plan.reason: _unlockTime is a Put-only parameter that immediately flows into the acc.unlockTime state write.
Local acc reference in Put only aliases the Acc mapping for the same function.
_am is a Collect-only parameter used exclusively in its balance check and external call.
Local acc reference in Collect only aliases Acc[msg.sender] within that function.
log is a constructor-only parameter consumed by the LogFile assignment.
_adr is an AddMessage-only parameter written into LastMsg.Sender.
_val is an AddMessage-only parameter written into LastMsg.Val.
_data is an AddMessage-only parameter written into LastMsg.Data.
